hint: A graphic can be shown on several slides. On the next slide with the same graphic only the text comes in anew — the picture stays, and what changes glides into place.
unused: not used on any slide yet
broken: This graphic cannot be drawn (its JSON has no parts).
howToUse: On a slide step: "drawing": "{ref}" — or with additions just for that slide: {"graphic": "{ref}", "add": [ … ], "change": {"<id>": { … }}, "hide": ["<id>"]}.
removeUsed: {count} slides show it — they will show no picture.
